title: Context Raises $9M Led by General Catalyst for AI Agents
summary:
The startup founded by Yahia has attracted 800+ customers for its tool that simplifies how developers search, scrape and monitor web data via a single API. The company, known as Context, raised $9M in a funding round led by General Catalyst to provide AI agents with real-time access to the internet. Robinhood Ventures and Orange Collective also participated in the financing.

The software enables AI agents to crawl and scrape the web to improve their situational awareness and data retrieval. The investment will support the expansion of this infrastructure to ensure AI tools are not limited by a lack of accessible context when performing web-based tasks.
